'''May 2000 Jacksonville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Big City CD's and Comics, Jacksonville, FL on 13 May 2000. [[Walter Cowart]] won it. It is known from Walter Cowart's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d739">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-jacksonville-fl-5-13-00d739/ jacksonville-fl-5-13-00], DeckTech (Walter "Walter" Cowart, 13 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-jacksonville-fl-5-13-00d739/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Big City CD's and Comics, Jacksonville, FL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Walter Cowart]]
